def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    from collections import Counter
    fives=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==5]
    colc=Counter(c for r,c in fives); rowc=Counter(r for r,c in fives)
    if max(colc.values())>=max(rowc.values()):  # vertical line
        vc=max(colc,key=lambda c:colc[c]); rows=sorted(r for r,c in fives if c==vc)
        cols=[c for c in range(w) if c!=vc and any(g[r][c] not in (0,5) for r in range(h))]
        prows=[r for r in range(h) if any(g[r][c] not in (0,5) for c in cols)]
        pat=[[g[r][c] for c in cols] for r in prows]
        ph=len(pat)
        for i,r in enumerate(rows):
            for j,c in enumerate(cols):
                out[r][c]=pat[i%ph][j]
    else:  # horizontal line
        hr=max(rowc,key=lambda r:rowc[r]); lcols=sorted(c for r,c in fives if r==hr)
        prows=[r for r in range(h) if r!=hr and any(g[r][c] not in (0,5) for c in range(w))]
        pcols=[c for c in range(w) if any(g[r][c] not in (0,5) for r in prows)]
        pat=[[g[r][c] for c in pcols] for r in prows]
        for r in prows:
            for j,c in enumerate(lcols):
                out[r][c]=pat[r-prows[0]][j%len(pat[0])]
    return out

        for i,r in enumerate(rows):

        pat=[[g[r][c] for c in cols] for r in prows]
        for i,r in enumerate(rows):
            for j,c in enumerate(cols):
                out[r][c]=pat[i%len(pat)][j]
    # horizontal line
    for hr,n in list(rowc.items()):
        if n<3: continue
        lcols=sorted(c for c in range(w) if g[hr][c]==5)
        prows=[r for r in range(h) if r!=hr and any(g[r][c] not in (0,5) for c in lcols)]
